author: WP11
summary: Despite its label this unit is an in-depth study of SDL_RENDERER: the execution-time 2D boundary, its single capability, the audit fixes, the open Wrap/Mirror decision, native versus emulated XNA features, readback coordinates and Xvfb evidence. Updated for the later pin, it is mostly current but wrong at 009d40f5 on public Clear (now throws), buffer-argument ordering, redundant rebinding, readback under scaling and the test-display default. libcna.com had only table rows and scattered cross-renderer mentions; a new deep dive carries the contract.

concepts.section: SDL Renderer in Depth
concepts.text: SDL_RENDERER is a 2D-only renderer on SDL3's own texture-blit renderer with no 3D pipeline, no programmable shader stage, no depth or stencil buffer and no multisampling; every texture is an SDL_PIXELFORMAT_RGBA32 SDL texture.

concepts.section: SDL Renderer in Depth
concepts.text: SDL_RENDERER belongs to the portable 2D group of the current renderer set together with FREEDIRECT, both usable on any SDL3 platform.

concepts.section: SDL Renderer in Depth
concepts.text: The renderer's raster route is SDL3 texture blits; it supports one RenderTarget2D at a time and neither MRT nor occlusion queries.
tokens: throws for more than one target

concepts.section: Scope, by design
concepts.text: Every 3D entry point that reaches SDL_RENDERER calls HandleUnsupported3DCall and throws std::runtime_error('SDL_Renderer does not support 3D: <method>') by default; under Unsupported3DGraphicsCallBehavior::WarnAndStub it warns once and returns a safe object.
concepts.note: The source said every entry point throws immediately; the WarnAndStub alternative is the TARGET qualification.

concepts.section: Scope, by design
concepts.text: A full-suite run once counted exactly thirteen expected pre-existing test failures on this renderer, each of them the 3D refusal.
concepts.note: A dated run count at an older revision; no such census is derivable at 009d40f5 and none was executed.

concepts.section: Scope, by design
concepts.text: A custom Effect passed to SpriteBatch::Begin throws on SDL_RENDERER because there is no shader stage to run it on.
tokens: no shader stage to run it on

concepts.section: The 2D boundary is at execution, not at every 3D-looking object
concepts.text: A VertexDeclaration is pure data (stride and elements, no device ownership, no renderer allocation), so all its constructor shapes work on SDL_RENDERER; the refusal happens only when a draw consumes it.

concepts.section: The 2D boundary is at execution, not at every 3D-looking object
concepts.text: SDL_Renderer_VertexDeclarationConstruction constructs every declaration shape, checks stride and element count, expects the exception at DrawUserPrimitives, then clears and reads back to show the device stayed usable.

concepts.section: The 2D boundary is at execution, not at every 3D-looking object
concepts.text: The five stock 3D effects can be constructed, configured and Apply()'d on SDL_RENDERER; only the primitive draw that follows throws.

concepts.section: The 2D boundary is at execution, not at every 3D-looking object
concepts.text: RasterizerState and DepthStencilState assignments round-trip as data but are applied through the interface's no-op defaults, because the family overrides neither ApplyRasterizerState nor ApplyDepthStencilState.

concepts.section: The 2D boundary is at execution, not at every 3D-looking object
concepts.text: VertexBuffer and IndexBuffer validate a positive count first (ArgumentOutOfRangeException, as XNA) and only then reach the renderer factory, which throws the 3D refusal; a 32-bit index buffer reports CreateIndexBuffer16 because the interface default delegates to it.
concepts.note: The source said the factories run before argument validation so a zero count yields the 3D error; at 009d40f5 validation runs first and the registered test asserts ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

concepts.section: A narrow positive capability among explicit refusals
concepts.text: IGraphicsRenderer's SupportsCapability default answers true for most members, but SDL_RENDERER overrides it with a single positive claim.
tokens: default answers true for most members

concepts.section: A narrow positive capability among explicit refusals
concepts.text: Only AdditiveBlending answers true, because SDL_ComposeCustomBlendMode expresses the Additive preset's separate colour and alpha equations exactly; the other 18 GraphicsCapability members, ThreeD included, answer false, and the claim does not imply arbitrary BlendState support.
concepts.note: The source counted thirteen capability values; GraphicsCapability has 19 members at 009d40f5.

concepts.section: A narrow positive capability among explicit refusals
concepts.text: ApplyBlendState maps ten Blend factors and all five BlendFunction values into an SDL custom blend mode, throws for BlendFactor, InverseBlendFactor and SourceAlphaSaturation, and cannot express ColorWriteChannels or MultiSampleMask.

concepts.section: A narrow positive capability among explicit refusals
concepts.text: Checking GraphicsCapability::ThreeD before taking a 3D path is strictly better than letting CreateVertexBuffer or a draw throw and catching it afterwards.
tokens: strictly better than catching the refusal

concepts.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
concepts.text: A 65-item technical audit of the renderer found and fixed fifteen defects; its closing document is a historical snapshot.
concepts.note: Audit counts belong to an older revision; the individual fixes that shaped current code are recorded as separate concepts.

concepts.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
concepts.text: SpriteBatch rotation on SDL_RENDERER offsets the destination by the scaled origin to match XNA's pivot, and a non-identity Begin transform matrix is drawn through SDL_RenderTextureAffine; both were defects in earlier builds.
tokens: Both were defects in earlier builds

concepts.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
concepts.text: The SpriteFont DrawString flip defect was fixed once in the shared SpriteBatch.cpp and therefore applies to every renderer, not only SDL_RENDERER.

target.evidence: docs/sdl-renderer-2d-completeness.md (CNA prose, SpriteFont row); modules/graphics/src/Xna/SpriteBatch.cpp; SDL_Renderer_SpriteFont_Effects registration

concepts.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
concepts.text: Blend presets other than Opaque and Additive used to map incorrectly and SpriteBatch Begin used to overwrite the device's blend mode; the current Begin leaves the state ApplyBlendState just set.

concepts.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
concepts.text: Four of nine TextureFilter values used to degrade to nearest; SDL has one scale mode per texture, so the magnification component now selects SDL_SCALEMODE_LINEAR or nearest.

concepts.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
concepts.text: SDL render targets report HasRealDepthBuffer false whatever depth format was requested; the requested DepthFormat is accepted and echoed but no depth test exists, and sampling a target as a texture goes through a small SDL-texture interface instead of an unchecked sibling cast.

concepts.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
concepts.text: RenderTargetUsage is shared-layer policy: a DiscardContents target is cleared to opaque black after a successful bind while Preserve and Platform keep colour, and rebinding an unchanged set returns early without clearing again.
concepts.note: The source said a redundant bind clears again on CNA while FNA returns early; at 009d40f5 CNA also returns early.

concepts.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
concepts.text: SetSwapInterval passes the exact interval (including 2 for PresentInterval::Two) to SDL_SetRenderVSync and retries with 1 if the driver refuses, but the constructor still maps any positive interval to 1, so direct construction with Two starts at 1 until a reset.

concepts.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
concepts.text: A renderer identity that wrapped SDL_RENDERER inherited its swap-interval and presentation-format behaviour.
concepts.note: That wrapping renderer is not among the 25 public identities at 009d40f5; its behaviour is not current documentation and its name is withheld by policy.

concepts.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
concepts.text: Neither construction nor reset passes the requested colour or depth format to SDL_RENDERER: SDL chooses the window output, every CNA texture is RGBA32, the applied-format hooks echo the request, and the fullscreen test proves stored state, no exception and continued pixels rather than display acceptance.

concepts.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
concepts.text: Missing disposed-resource checks in the sprite path and SetRenderTargets and a dangling pointer after RenderTarget2D::Dispose were fixed and are held by registered tests.

concepts.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
concepts.text: An OcclusionQuery cannot be created on SDL_RENDERER: the public OcclusionQuery constructor refuses when the device reports no occlusion support, and the renderer factory also refuses for direct callers.
concepts.note: The source attributed the refusal to a null renderer at construction; at 009d40f5 the public constructor checks the false capability first.

concepts.section: One blocked sampler decision, and one resource gap that later closed
concepts.text: SpriteBatch Wrap and Mirror are not honoured: SDL_RenderTexture's source-rectangle path has one fixed clamp-like edge behaviour, SDL_SetRenderTextureAddressMode affects only SDL_RenderGeometry, and the family never overrides SetSamplerAddressMode.

concepts.section: One blocked sampler decision, and one resource gap that later closed
concepts.text: Three remedies were identified for Wrap/Mirror and none was chosen: refuse any request, move the sprite path onto SDL_RenderGeometry, or refuse only when a source rectangle exceeds the texture.

concepts.section: One blocked sampler decision, and one resource gap that later closed
concepts.text: The former silent Texture3D/TextureCube gap is closed: Texture3D checks the false capability and throws NotSupportedException, and TextureCube SetData/GetData throw when no native resource exists; shared read/write contract fixtures pin both on this renderer.

concepts.section: One blocked sampler decision, and one resource gap that later closed
concepts.text: A 94-test blast-radius estimate once deferred a blanket cube-construction refusal.
concepts.note: Planning history that explains an old deferral; the current observable contract is the one in the closed-gap concept.

concepts.section: What ``clamp-like by coincidence'' means in pixels
concepts.text: Drawing a 2x1 red/blue texture with a source rectangle twice its width and PointClamp yields blue at source position 1.25, the XNA-correct clamp result, only because of SDL's fixed edge behaviour; SDL_Renderer_TextureAddressModeClamp asserts it.

concepts.section: What ``clamp-like by coincidence'' means in pixels
concepts.text: With PointWrap the XNA answer at that position is red but SDL_RENDERER produces blue again, so tiled scrolling backgrounds silently show the wrong pixel without an exception; the clamp test prints this value without asserting it.

concepts.section: Native and emulated behavior
concepts.text: MultiSampleCount is accepted on SDL_RENDERER, logged once per non-zero request and applied as 0.

concepts.section: Native and emulated behavior
concepts.text: Fullscreen toggling round-trips at the API level, but real OS fullscreen acceptance cannot be verified in the headless test environment.
tokens: not that a display accepted the mode

concepts.section: Native and emulated behavior
concepts.text: A Clear that names DepthBuffer or Stencil throws InvalidOperationException in GraphicsDevice before any SDL_RENDERER hook runs, so the renderer's own depth and stencil clear hooks are reachable only by direct renderer callers; SDL_Renderer_ClearOptions_Audit still expects a stencil-only clear to be a silent no-op.
concepts.note: The source said public Clear masks both bits into a silent no-op and that throwing tests were stale; at 009d40f5 the device throws, and it is the stencil-only expectation of the audit test that is stale.

concepts.section: Native and emulated behavior
concepts.text: Five multi-frame compatibility samples (a 2D demo, a bouncing sprite, a keyboard sprite, a two-glyph SpriteFont text and an animated sprite sheet) are registered CTests for SDL_RENDERER.

concepts.section: Native and emulated behavior
concepts.text: SDL_RENDERER has no SetViewport override: a custom viewport changes stored state and Viewport projection maths but never remaps an SDL sprite.

concepts.section: Native and emulated behavior
concepts.text: A positive ScissorRectangle installs an SDL clip and a non-positive size removes it; with no rasteriser-state hook the clip applies even when ScissorTestEnable is false, and the existing rasteriser construction test cannot detect it.
tokens: never sets a scissor rectangle with the test disabled

concepts.section: Native and emulated behavior
concepts.text: The scissor divergence is preserved in an inherited multi-product viewport and scissor audit matrix.
concepts.note: A cross-reference to another manuscript section's audit matrix; the current per-family viewport and scissor rows live on the render-target deep dive.

concepts.section: Reading the feature matrix for this renderer
concepts.text: The renderer's feature-matrix document is a dated planning snapshot: its custom-Effect refusal and its open Wrap/Mirror decision are accurate, its cube/volume row was closed later, and its pass totals are not a live census.

concepts.section: Xvfb screenshot evidence
concepts.text: Unlike SOFTWARE, SDL_RENDERER needs a display server; its tests carry SDL_VIDEODRIVER=x11 and DISPLAY=${CNA_TEST_DISPLAY}, whose default is now empty (inherit the caller's display), with :0 honoured only together with CNA_TEST_ALLOW_LIVE_DISPLAY=ON.
concepts.note: The source said CNA_TEST_DISPLAY defaults to :0; at 009d40f5 the default is empty and the live desktop is opt-in.

concepts.section: Xvfb screenshot evidence
concepts.text: An Xvfb campaign built the screenshot demo, rendered the shared rotate-around-origin SpriteBatch scene and saved it with SaveBackBufferScreenshotEXT; the red marker landed in the destination's top-right corner.

concepts.section: Pixel readback and presentation mode
concepts.text: SDL_RENDERER pixel fixtures select PresentationMode::NativeBackBuffer because SDL_RenderReadPixels works in physical output coordinates while callers pass logical ones.

concepts.section: Pixel readback and presentation mode
concepts.text: ReadBackbuffer maps a back-buffer request through SDL_GetRenderLogicalPresentationRect and throws on a physical/logical size mismatch instead of returning aliased pixels; with a target bound the coordinates address the target directly.
concepts.note: The source said a scaled presentation could make a coordinate check sample the wrong pixel; at 009d40f5 the renderer refuses the read.

concepts.section: Animated sprite-sheet frame selection
concepts.text: The animated sprite-sheet sample advances a counter per Update instead of elapsed time and reselects the SpriteBatch source rectangle from it, so the outcome never depends on frame timing.
tokens: advances a counter instead of using elapsed time

concepts.section: Animated sprite-sheet frame selection
concepts.text: After three updates the sample reads the rendered pixel rather than trusting the frame-index arithmetic; without NativeBackBuffer a failure would concern the fixture, not the animation.
tokens: that failure would concern the fixture

concepts.section: How to prove the SDL 2D route
concepts.text: Proving the SDL 2D route means observing the actual target and presentation mode, exercising target bind and unbind, reading back a discriminating sprite and asserting the 3D refusal; a screenshot alone can look plausible while exercising the wrong rectangle.
tokens: a screenshot alone can look plausible

concepts.section: How to prove the SDL 2D route
concepts.text: No workflow runs the SDL_Renderer_* family tests: they are not registered on Windows or Emscripten, and the automatic jobs that configure SDL_RENDERER run the input label and selected Apple platform and storage suites instead.
tokens: No workflow runs these family tests

issues.text: SpriteBatch TextureAddressMode Wrap/Mirror are silently not honoured on SDL_RENDERER (clamp-like result); decision open.
SDL_RENDERER applies the scissor rectangle even when RasterizerState.ScissorTestEnable is false.
SdlRenderer constructor maps any positive swap interval to 1, so PresentInterval::Two at construction starts at 1.
SDL_Renderer_ClearOptions_Audit expects a stencil-only Clear to be a silent no-op, but GraphicsDevice::Clear now throws InvalidOperationException for unavailable aspects.
No CI workflow runs the SDL_Renderer_* family CTests; they are not registered on Windows, where SDL_RENDERER is the default.
